multi_entity_note: Single patient (pregnant woman); fetus and clinicians mentioned only in passing.

medical.diagnosis.rationale: The summary names the underlying diagnoses as SS (Sjogren's syndrome, causing distal RTA and hypokalaemia) and leptospirosis; hypokalaemia/acidosis/RTA are manifestations.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: Ceftriaxone is the only drug given for a final diagnosis (leptospirosis); potassium and bicarbonate treated the electrolyte and acid-base disturbances.
